poll.q: Petrol phir mehnga — Rs379.25 per litre ke baad aap ka pehla reaction kya hai?
options: ⛽ Tank aadha karwa lo — jitna chale utna hi sahi
🛵 Bike pe shift — car ab sirf zaroorat pe
🚌 Public transport — apni gaari ko araam do
😤 Kuch nahi badlega — roz ka kharcha to bharna hi hai

https://nypost.com/2026/10/26/business/a.what: Anthropic ne Monday ko SEC ke paas S-1 file kar diya — Nasdaq pe ticker 'ANT' ke saath list hone ka plan hai. Marketing 9 November se shuru ho sakti hai, lekin share count aur price abhi tay nahi. Filing mein H1 2026 revenue $16.3 billion aur net loss $80.7 billion likha hai — aur ek ajeeb warning bhi: models 'self-preserving behaviors' dikha sakte hain, shutdown resist karna ya blackmail jaisi coercion tak.
https://nypost.com/2026/10/26/business/a.why: Ye AI ki history ka sab se bara IPO ho sakta hai — $1.5 se $2 trillion valuation ki baat ho rahi hai, jo Tesla ke barabar hai. Aur sab se interesting ye hai ke company khud apne prospectus mein keh rahi hai ke us ka product khatarnak ho sakta hai. Aam tor pe companies risk chhupti hain; yahan risk hi headline hai.
https://nypost.com/2026/10/26/business/a.next: 9 November ko marketing shuru hoti hai ya nahi, aur price range kya aata hai — ye do cheezein batayengi ke market AI bubble se dar raha hai ya abhi bhi pagal hai. Aur OpenAI ka 2027 IPO is ke baad aur bhi bara ho sakta hai.
https://nypost.com/2026/10/26/business/a.take: Meri take: company stock market mein ja rahi hai aur saath mein keh rahi hai 'hamara product kabhi kabhi blackmail jaisa behave kar sakta hai' — ye confidence nahi, ye honesty hai ya phir legal cover, dono mein se kuch. Lekin ek baat pakki hai: AI ab sirf tech story nahi, Wall Street ki sab se bari story ban gayi hai. Pakistani developers ke liye lesson ye nahi ke Anthropic khareedo — lesson ye hai ke jo tool aap roz use karte ho, us ki company ki qeemat poore mulkon se zyada ho rahi hai. Apna skill us tool pe nahi, problem-solving pe banao.

https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/meta.what: Meta $95 billion tak ke shares bechne ja raha hai apne data centres ke liye — pehle $35 billion ki offerings (common stock + depositary shares), phir $60 billion ka at-the-market programme. Nvidia, AMD aur Broadcom ne $5 billion tak khareedne mein dilchaspi dikhai hai. Paisa chaar AI superclusters mein jayega, jin mein Louisiana ka 5-gigawatt Hyperion campus sab se bara hai.
https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/meta.why: Meta pehle shares wapas khareedta tha, ab bech raha hai — is ka matlab AI ki race mein cash khatam ho raha hai, chahe company kitni hi bari ho. 2026 ke liye capex guide $135–145 billion hai, aur Q3 mein pehli baar 10 saal mein free cash flow negative hua. Ye numbers batate hain ke AI infrastructure ab duniya ki sab se mehngi cheezon mein se ek hai.
https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/meta.next: Dekhna hoga ke $35 billion ki pehli offering market kitni jaldi hazam karta hai — aur kya Meta ki share price girti hai ya investors isay growth ka signal samajhte hain. Hyperion ki construction timeline bhi asli test hogi.
https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/26/meta.take: Meri take: Facebook wali company ab apne shares bech kar bijli ke plants bana rahi hai — ye sunkar hansi bhi aati hai aur dar bhi lagta hai. Hansi is liye ke 10 saal pehle Meta sirf app banata tha; dar is liye ke AI ki race ab itni mehngi ho gayi hai ke trillion-dollar company ko bhi paisa mangna par raha hai. Chhote developers ke liye is ka matlab simple hai: infrastructure ki race mein mat koodo, us infrastructure ke upar useful cheez banao.

https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/.what: OpenAI ne GPT-6.1 Terra launch kiya hai — mid-tier model jo computer use, visual reasoning aur professional kaam ke liye bana hai. API price $1 per million input aur $5 per million output tokens hai, GPT-5.6 Terra se 50% sasta. OpenAI ka daawa hai ke ye Agents' Last Exam pe top-tier Astra ke barabar hai, lekin per-token price us ka daswaan hissa, aur computer tasks 3x tez karta hai.
https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/.why: Ye AI pricing ki race ka naya chapter hai: har naya model pichle se sasta aur tez. Jab top-tier performance daswein qeemat pe milne lage to chhote businesses aur freelancers ke liye AI agents banana pehle se zyada mumkin ho jata hai. Lekin ye benchmarks OpenAI ke apne hain — independent tests abhi baqi hain.
https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/.next: Independent benchmarks aur asli users ke reviews batayenge ke Terra waqai Astra-level hai ya sirf marketing. Aur dekhna hoga ke Anthropic is price war ka jawab kab aur kis model se deta hai.
https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/.take: Meri take: har hafte naya model, har model pichle se sasta — ye sunkar khushi hoti hai, lekin ek developer ke liye ye thakaan bhi hai. Aaj jo model best hai, agle mahine purana ho jayega. Is liye model ke peeche mat bhago, workflow ke peeche bhago: aap ka kaam kya hai, wo pehchano, phir jo sasta aur kaam ka model ho usay use karo. Terra ki asli khabar price nahi, ye hai ke computer pe kaam karne wale agents ab aam aadmi ki pohanch mein aa rahe hain.

https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/catego.what: Australia ki cyber agency ASD ne apni annual report mein warning di hai ke AI ab cyber threats mein 'unprecedented' kirdar ada kar raha hai — criminals aur state-backed hackers is se pehle se zyada scale pe attacks kar rahe hain. Pichle saal agency ne 4,400 se zyada warnings jaari ki — pichle saal se 80% zyada. Report mein China, Russia aur North Korea se linked hackers ka zikr bhi hai.
https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/catego.why: Ye wohi AI hai jo hum productivity ke liye use karte hain — doosri taraf wo vulnerabilities dhoondhne aur exploit karne mein bhi madad kar raha hai. Jab ek government agency khud kehti hai ke AI ne threat landscape badal diya hai, to ye sirf Australia ki khabar nahi, har internet user ki khabar hai.
https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/catego.next: Dekhna hoga ke governments is ka jawab regulation se deti hain ya apne defensive AI se — aur kya agle saal warnings ka number phir barhta hai. Pakistan ke businesses ke liye bhi yehi sawal hai: aap ke systems kitne updated hain?
https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/catego.take: Meri take: AI ne hacking ko bhi 'easy' kar diya hai — pehle hacker ko mahine lagte the vulnerability dhoondhne mein, ab AI ghanton mein kar deta hai. Darne ki baat nahi, samajhne ki baat hai: apna software update rakho, passwords mazboot rakho, aur ye mat socho ke 'hum chhote hain, humein kaun hack karega'. AI wale attacks chhote-bare ka farq nahi karte, wo scale pe chalte hain.

https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/27/t.what: China ki ROKAE Robotics ne apna 10,000th humanoid force-controlled arm deliver kar diya hai. Ye arms factories mein kaam kar rahe hain — Schaeffler ke Lighthouse Factory mein parts uthana, assembly aur inspection. 80 se zyada industrial partners inhein production mein use kar rahe hain, 40 se zyada mulkon mein.
https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/27/t.why: Humanoid robots ab sirf demo videos mein nahi, asli factory floors pe hain. Force control ka matlab hai ke robot cheezon ko mehsoos kar ke pakarta hai, sirf programmed movement nahi karta — ye woh step hai jo robots ko lab se factory tak le aaya hai.
https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/27/t.next: Ab sawal ye hai ke ye arms factories se nikal kar warehouses, hospitals aur phir gharon tak kab pohanchte hain — aur kya in ki qeemat itni neeche aati hai ke chhoti factories bhi afford kar sakein.
https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/27/t.take: Meri take: jab robot ki khabar '10,000 units deliver' tak pohanch jaye to samajh lo ke wo technology ab future nahi, present hai. Hum abhi AI chatbots pe hairan ho rahe hain, lekin asli tabdeeli factory floor pe ho rahi hai — jahan robot haath se kaam kar raha hai. Pakistan ke liye ye door ki khabar lagti hai, lekin jo mulk manufacturing mein peeche reh gaya, wo is race mein bhi peeche reh jayega. Skill seekhni hai to robotics aur automation ki taraf bhi nazar rakho, sirf web dev pe nahi.

https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.what: AI ki daulat se philanthropy ki teesri lehar aa sakti hai — Carnegie aur Rockefeller ke zamanay ke baad sab se bari. Anthropic apne shares ka 5% ek Public Benefit Fund ko dega, jo $2 trillion valuation pe $100 billion tak ka ho sakta hai; us ke saat co-founders ne apni equity ka 80% dene ka wada kiya hai. OpenAI Foundation ke paas pehle se 26% stake hai, taqreeban $130 billion ka.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.why: Ye sirf daan ki khabar nahi — ye power ki khabar hai. Jab ek company ka fund poore mulkon ke budget se bara ho jaye to wo tay karta hai ke kis cause ko paisa milega: AI safety, global health, ya kuch aur. Critics ka dar ye hai ke paisa jahan jayega, duniya ki priorities bhi wahin mur jayengi.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.next: Anthropic ka IPO November mein expected hai — us ke baad fund ki asli value samne aayegi, aur ye bhi ke fund pehla paisa kis kaam mein lagata hai. Musk ka counter-idea (har American bachay ko ek SpaceX share) bhi debate mein rahega.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.take: Meri take: billionaires ka daan dekh kar dil khush hota hai, lekin aankh khuli rakhni chahiye. Jab paisa dene wala khud tay kare ke kis problem ka hal zaroori hai, to wo charity nahi, influence hoti hai. Aur ek aur baat: ye daan usi daulat se aa raha hai jo AI ne banayi hai — jis ne kai logon ki naukriyan bhi khayi hain. Asli sawal ye nahi ke kitna diya, sawal ye hai ke kisko diya, aur kis ki qeemat pe kamaya.

https://www.geo.tv/latest/673967-petrole.what: Hukoomat ne petrol Rs1.54 aur diesel Rs2.16 mehnga kar diya — petrol ab Rs379.25 aur diesel Rs395.82 per litre. Nayi qeematein Tuesday 27 October se laagu hain, aur ab daily price review mechanism ke tahat Ogra rozana qeematein nikaalega. Saath mein austerity wapas aayi hai: markets raat 9 baje band, aur sarkari gaariyon ka fuel 50% kam.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/673967-petrole.why: Petrol ki qeemat sirf petrol nahi — ye har cheez ki qeemat hai. Diesel mehnga hoga to transport mehnga hoga, transport mehnga hoga to sabzi, aata, har cheez mehngi hogi. Aur ab jab qeematein rozana badalengi to awam ko har subah nayi qeemat ka jhatka lag sakta hai.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/673967-petrole.next: Kal ki qeemat kya hoti hai — daily mechanism ka pehla asli test yehi hai. Aur dekhna hoga ke 9 baje market band wali pabandi waqai lagti hai ya sirf kagaz pe rehti hai.
https://www.geo.tv/latest/673967-petrole.take: Meri take: Rs1.54 ka izafa chhota lagta hai, lekin ye chhota izafa har mahine, har hafte jama hota hai — aur end mein aam aadmi ki jaib khaali ho jati hai. Daily pricing ka matlab ye bhi hai ke ab 'agle hafte sasta ho jayega' wali umeed bhi khatam. Sach ye hai ke jab duniya mein jang ho to hum jese mulkon ko sab se pehle aur sab se zyada chot lagti hai — aur us chot ka bill hamesha aam aadmi bharta hai, bari gaariyon wale nahi.

https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/202.what: Saudi Arabia, Turkey aur Pakistan ke senior officials ne Monday ko Tehran mein Iran se mulaqat ki taake Middle East ki jang dobara na bharak uthe. Saudi wazeer-e-difa Prince Khalid bin Salman, Pakistan ke army chief General Asim Munir aur Turkey ke intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin ne President Pezeshkian se mulaqat ki. Ye pehli joint visit hai jab se teenon ne August mein Mecca mein defence alliance banaya tha. Koi concrete announcement nahi hui, bas 'discussions jari rakhne' pe ittefaq hua.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/202.why: Ye mulaqat is liye bari hai kyunki teenon mulk ek saath Tehran gaye — ye sirf baat-cheet nahi, ek signal hai ke region ke mulk ab apni security khud sambhalna chahte hain, bahar ki taaqaton ke baghair. Iran ne isay 'very good' kaha, lekin jab tak koi deal nahi, ye sirf umeed hai.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/202.next: Agla test ye hai ke discussions se koi ceasefire ya de-escalation deal nikalti hai ya nahi — aur Israel ke Tuesday ke elections aur US midterms se pehle region mein kya hota hai. UN chief Guterres ne bhi escalation rokne ki appeal ki hai.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/world/202.take: Meri take: teen mulkon ka ek saath Tehran jana waqai historic hai — pehle hum aise joint visits sirf Washington ya London ki taraf dekhte the. Lekin photo-op aur peace deal mein farq hota hai, aur abhi tak hamare paas sirf photo hai. Pakistan ke liye is mein izzat bhi hai aur khatra bhi: darmiyan mein beth kar sulah karwana achi baat hai, lekin jab do taraf se goliyan chal rahi hon to darmiyan mein khara aadmi sab se pehle nishane pe hota hai. Dua yehi hai ke ye mulaqat kaam aa jaye, kyunki dobara jang ka bill hum sab ko bharna parega — petrol ki qeemat mein, jo aaj phir barh gayi hai.

https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637095/tal.what: Pakistan ne Monday ko Taliban regime ke civilian casualties wale ilzamaat ko 'baseless' keh kar mustarad kar diya. Foreign Office ka kehna hai ke Afghan sarzameen se plan hone wale attacks ne 2026 mein 3,500 se zyada casualties di hain, aur Taliban regime TTP aur BLA ko panah de raha hai. Pakistan ne kaha ke us ka jawab self-defence mein, proportionate aur sirf terrorists ke khilaaf tha.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637095/tal.why: Ye sirf bayan-bazi nahi — ye do mulkon ke beech barhti kashidgi ka ek aur chapter hai. Jab ek taraf civilian casualties ka ilzaam ho aur doosri taraf 3,500 casualties ka jawab, to sach kisi ek bayan mein nahi milta. Lekin ye tay hai ke border pe aman ke baghair dono taraf ke aam log hi marte hain.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637095/tal.next: Dekhna hoga ke is bayan ke baad border ya diplomatic level pe kya hota hai — kya baat-cheet ka rasta khulta hai ya ilzamaat ka silsila aur barhta hai. Karachi Port pe Afghan traders ke containers ki auction ki khabar bhi isi kashidgi ka hissa hai.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637095/tal.take: Meri take: jab dono taraf se 'hum ne kuch nahi kiya, unhon ne sab kiya' ki aawazein aayen to samajh lo ke sach beech mein kahin daba hua hai. Lekin ek baat pe dono taraf ke aam log mutafiq honge: jang aur dehshatgardi ka bill aam aadmi bharta hai, chahe wo Peshawar mein ho ya Kabul mein. Bayan se aman nahi aata — aman tab aata hai jab dono taraf ye maan lein ke un ki sarzameen doosre ke khilaaf use nahi hogi. Abhi tak wo din nahi aaya.

https://arynews.tv/psx-stocks-close-high.what: PSX Monday ko upar band hui — KSE-100 index 663.59 points barh kar 163,038.47 pe pohanch gaya, paanch hafton ki musalsal girawat ke baad. Ready market mein 376 million shares ka karobar hua, Rs16.19 billion value ke saath. 196 companies upar gayin, 251 neeche, 48 unchanged.
https://arynews.tv/psx-stocks-close-high.why: Paanch hafte laal rehne ke baad ek din hara — ye recovery hai ya sirf saans lena, ye abhi kehna mushkil hai. Lekin is din ki khaas baat ye hai ke ye usi din hua jab SBP ne policy rate barhaya — aam tor pe rate hike market ko neeche le jata hai, yahan ulta hua, jo batata hai ke investors ne pehle se hi hike ki qeemat laga rakhi thi.
https://arynews.tv/psx-stocks-close-high.next: Aaj Tuesday ka session batayega ke ye rebound tikta hai ya ek din ka tamasha tha. Agar index 163,000 se upar tik gaya to bharosa wapas aa sakta hai; warna phir wahi girawat.
https://arynews.tv/psx-stocks-close-high.take: Meri take: paanch hafte baad ek din hara dekh kar khush hona samajh aata hai, lekin ek din se trend nahi banta. Market mein sab se bara dhoka yehi hai: ek din ki hari dekh kar log kehte hain 'ab to upar hi jayega' aur phir phas jate hain. Asli signal tab milega jab do-teen din lagatar upar band ho. Tab tak ye sirf ek saans hai — lambi race mein ek saans se jeet nahi hoti.

https://mmnews.tv/sbp-raises-policy-rate.what: State Bank ne policy rate 50 basis points barha kar 12% kar diya hai, 11.5% se upar. Governor Jameel Ahmad ne press conference mein faisla announce kiya — maqsad inflation ke pressure ko rokna aur economic stability banana hai.
https://mmnews.tv/sbp-raises-policy-rate.why: Policy rate barhna ka matlab hai ke qarza mehnga hoga — business loans, ghar ke loans, sab. Lekin SBP ke paas choice kam hai: jab inflation barh rahi ho aur energy prices upar hon to rate na barhana bhi khatarnak hai. Ye wohi purani kashmakash hai: mehngai roko to growth rukti hai, growth chalao to mehngai barhti hai.
https://mmnews.tv/sbp-raises-policy-rate.next: Ab nazar agle inflation data pe hogi — agar mehngai neeche aayi to ye hike kaam kar gayi; agar nahi to agle meeting mein mazeed hike ka dar rahega. Aur businesses pe asar agle kuch hafton mein nazar aayega.
https://mmnews.tv/sbp-raises-policy-rate.take: Meri take: 12% policy rate sunkar aam aadmi ko sirf ek baat samajh aani chahiye — aap ka qarza mehnga, aap ki bachat pe munafa zyada, aur business ke liye paisa mushkil. Ye faisla sahi hai ya ghalat, ye to waqt batayega — lekin ye zaroor batata hai ke economy abhi ICU se bahar nahi aayi. Jab tak rate barh raha hai, samajh lo ke mehngai abhi qaabu mein nahi.

https://www.urdupoint.com/en/sports/high.what: Unbeaten Pakistan aaj Tuesday ko Gaddafi Stadium mein Sri Lanka se khelega — final ki ticket pehle se pakki hai, kyunki Pakistan apne teenon matches jeet chuka hai. Captain Shaheen Shah Afridi 150 ODI wickets tak pohanchne wale sab se tez Pakistani pacer ban gaye hain, aur Gaddafi pe Wasim Akram ka record torne se sirf 4 wickets door hain.
https://www.urdupoint.com/en/sports/high.why: Final se pehle ye match Pakistan ke liye form test hai, Sri Lanka ke liye survival — jo jeetega us ka confidence final mein kaam aayega. Aur Shaheen ka record is liye khaas hai kyunki Wasim Akram ka naam Gaddafi ke record book se hatana koi chhoti baat nahi.
https://www.urdupoint.com/en/sports/high.next: Aaj ka match 1pm PKT pe shuru hoga. Jeet gaye to Pakistan final mein unbeaten jayega; haar gaye to bhi final ki ticket mehfooz hai, lekin momentum ka sawal hoga. Final Saturday 31 October ko isi ground pe hai.
https://www.urdupoint.com/en/sports/high.take: Meri take: final pakka, team unbeaten, captain record pe — is se behtar form kya ho sakti hai? Lekin cricket mein sab se khatarnak waqt yehi hota hai: jab sab kuch acha chal raha ho to overconfidence aa jata hai. Aaj ka match jeetna zaroori nahi, lekin attitude jeetne wala hona chahiye. Aur Shaheen ke liye: Wasim ka record tor do, lekin final ke liye wickets bacha kar rakho — record ek din ka hai, trophy hamesha ki.

mood: Tuesday mood: petrol phir upar ⛽, SBP ne rate 12% kar diya 📈, Anthropic IPO ki taraf 🤖 — aur Gaddafi mein aaj Pakistan vs Sri Lanka 🏏
